title: A Page to Copy

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Welcome, welcome! Come in out of the cold. In winter the brothers do their most careful work: copying books by hand.

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: One book is so old its words are fading. Would you help me copy them onto a fresh page? Listen to each word, and set down its sounds.

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear? Put each letter in its place.

older.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear, first to last? Find each letter in the box.

feedback.wrong: Listen again: {word}. That sound goes somewhere else.
feedback.all_good: A whole page, saved for a hundred years more!

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: When we copy a book, its words live on for people who aren't even born yet. That's patient work, and good work.

journal_line: I copied words from an old book with Brother Elias.
